name: pbrain
description: AI-native project and portfolio brain for strategy workstreams, tasks, research, ingestion, and weekly operating memory.

interface.shortDescription: Operate strategy projects as living brains.
interface.longDescription: pbrain manages local project context, workstream ledgers, cross-project portfolio indexes, task rollups, research, ingestion, maintenance, and end-of-week summaries. Local project folders stay authoritative; the global portfolio brain indexes and links across projects.
defaultPrompt: Use pbrain to set up this strategy project.
Use pbrain to refresh my workstream ledgers.
Use pbrain to create an end-of-week summary.
